lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.13 - A Listen and say. Then practise.

details: Listen and say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, clear sounds, and confident repetition.
“I went shopping last night! Look at all my new clothes. Do you like them?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.13 - B. Stick. Then ask and answer.

details: Stick checks understanding of word to sound. Ask and answer gives students controlled practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for accurate matching of audio and sticker, and correct use of the question, clear answers and turn taking.
“Look, they have new clothes too! Can you help me find out what they are wearing? Do you have your stickers ready?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.67 - AB homework check

details:
Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.67 - A Look and write

details: Look and write tests students ability to write a word correctly using given visuals.
Look for word recognition skills when viewing the visual through their choice of word and neat handwriting in their books.
“Would you like to go shopping? Let’s write down the words for these clothes in this crossword. Then we can look for them in the shops”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.67 - B Look and tick

details: Look and tick tests their understanding and recognition of words to the correct image. Students read word choices and look at visuals, then show understanding by identifying the correct word.
Look for word recognition skills when viewing the visual through their choice of word and neat ticking in their books.
“Our friends are all wearing their new clothes- what are they wearing?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.14 - Speaking Choose three people, but don’t tell. Play a guessing game with your friend.

details: Ask and answer gives students controlled practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for turn taking and correct and confident use of target structures.
“We can all wear our new clothes to the fair. If anyone gets lost, we can just remember what they are wearing.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (closed pairs): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (open pairs): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs
Read, listen and sing provides the opportunity to recognise the target structure and vocabulary in a song as well as practising reading and listening skills.
Look for accurate reading as well as good pronunciation as they follow the lyrics and finally sing the song as a group.
“We’ve found everyone! Let’s sing a song together to celebrate.”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Sing): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video Song): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Diary:
Revisit the diary page so Ss can add new words or phrases, revisit their learning goal and complete tracking for that lesson.
